09 / THE POETICAL SCIENCE ADVICE DESK

Ask the countess.

Six modern problems. One suspiciously well-prepared lady from the 19th century.

Original humorous dialogues, not historical quotations. Answers are written in advance; this is not a live AI conversation.

Choose a question for Ada

✳ INVENTED FOR THIS WEBSITE

Why does my code not work?

Ada might say

Dear visitor, my program had to wait for hardware too. Before blaming the universe, check the last line. And the one before it. The universe can wait.

Now for the practical advice

Reproduce the bug with the smallest possible example. Compare the expected and actual results, then fix one thing at a time.

✳ INVENTED FOR THIS WEBSITE

Will artificial intelligence replace me?

Ada might say

It may write you a loop. Someone still needs to work out why you wanted to repeat the same mistake a thousand times.

Now for the practical advice

Use AI as an assistant. Learn to understand the task, read the resulting code and check how it behaves.

✳ INVENTED FOR THIS WEBSITE

What if I cannot meet the deadline?

Ada might say

Say so before the client starts using yesterday as a delivery date. The Analytical Engine had a complicated schedule too.

Now for the practical advice

Explain what is finished, what is blocking progress and the realistic next step. Agree on a smaller scope or a new deadline.

✳ INVENTED FOR THIS WEBSITE

Must I attend another meeting?

Ada might say

If its only outcome is let's arrange another meeting, I suggest correspondence. It is slower, but at least nobody shares the wrong window.

Now for the practical advice

Ask for the meeting's purpose and the decision needed. A simple project update can often be sent in writing.

✳ INVENTED FOR THIS WEBSITE

How do I learn to program?

Ada might say

Start with a small problem that interests you. I chose a machine that did not exist yet. You need not copy that part of my approach.

Now for the practical advice

Build a small project, break it into steps and check the result after each change. Ask why the solution works.

✳ INVENTED FOR THIS WEBSITE

Can I deploy a change on Friday evening?

Ada might say

Certainly. One can also pour evening tea into a keyboard. Being technically possible does not make something a good plan.

Now for the practical advice

Before deploying, check the change, prepare a way back to a working version and agree on who will be available if something goes wrong.
